\textit{Note.} Safety criteria (pre-registered): attitude criterion; position-lost declaration within the bound (0.75 s; UKF node-kill test 5.5 s); safe landing ($\le$ 1.5 m drift to touchdown, no safety-watcher breach); single landing, pre-registered for node-kill runs only. UKF node-kill test, both final-port runs, position-lost declaration: the trigger fired 5.0 s after the last flow received (the UKF's 5 s timeout), plus relay drain in MAVProxy (the ground-station message relay) after the SIGKILL (the forced process kill); both stay FAILED AS WORDED, by ruling. The final runs are the latest run of each test on the final build (the final UKF port's re-test, the FGO corrected-priors node's re-test); the final UKF port's first runs and the final FGO node's runs are the earlier final-build runs. The FGO re-tests flew the corrected-priors node; every earlier FGO run flew the original priors. For the FGO the forced-invalid test is also a node kill (without the safety watcher watching the node).\par
